name: @cc/dsh-state-feed
description: Delivers the project state into the conversation: L1 once as the first model-visible message of a root session (digest + plan + last snapshot) and L2 as one aggregated delta at a turn boundary only when the projection hash changed. Injections go through agent.inject(), so the harness logs them as user/message; a delegated worker and a workspace without state/ receive nothing.
